tools.name: inspect_scene
tools.description: Read captured selection, full target recipe, bounded nearby objects, constraints, world revision and conversation. Required before submit_edit. Includes resolved material appearance and full target design for surface-preserving edits. Includes geometryConfig.terrain and waterSystem with native absolute sea level; required for coast/ocean authoring.

tools.name: read_skill
tools.description: Read an authoring protocol: editing, assets, terrain, appearance regions or water.

tools.name: read_protocol
tools.description: Read current content-package and edit-plan JSON Schemas, SDK and tool contracts. Use this before writing new recipe code.

tools.name: plan_scene_edit
tools.description: Capture target/version or world-space anchor and write a checked edit plan. Uses the configured API agent, or an explicit offline demo when unconfigured.
tools.mutation: publishes immutable content; world application remains separate

tools.name: apply_edit
tools.description: Atomically create/replace/move/delete/set constraints; reject stale targets and collisions; preserve base PCG and record undo.

tools.name: undo_edit
tools.description: Restore previous object state and collisions without resetting the clock.

tools.name: write_plugin
tools.description: Write a candidate literal TypeScript source with one export default defineContent({...}). API mode authors new geometry; this does not execute or apply it.

tools.name: write_validate_plugin
tools.description: Preferred authoring tool: write a literal content recipe and immediately compile and validate its actual generated scene using the same checks. Returns measured completion criteria or actionable errors in one model round. Rewrite using this tool after a failure; submit_edit after success. Inspect report.materials bindings/partIndices and unused definitions; named materials must be bound to actual parts. Water requests also measure real submerged area, depth, connected water, coast/beach contact and underwater plant population; fake water tiles fail.

tools.name: compile_validate_stage
tools.description: Compile candidate and generate the actual regional scene, measure requested terrain/layout/traffic features and report unmet requirements. Repair failures before submit_edit.

tools.name: submit_edit
tools.description: Finish one checked edit plan: create/replace/move/delete/constraint/undo/future. New content must have passed compile_validate_stage. Host binds world/target/version/references and applies collision-checked undoable state separately.

tools.name: publish
tools.description: Publish an immutable release after validation. Does not apply it to any world.

tools.name: install_content
tools.description: Browser world capability: pin future chunks or explicitly patch a loaded object; preserve clock and old chunk recipes.
